hints.title: Directed Acyclic Reachability Query
hints.text: The richer relationship forms a DAG where edges direct from richer people to poorer people. For any person, candidates are that person and all ancestors reachable along richer edges.

hints.title: Memoized Transitive Minimum Invariant
hints.text: The quietest person among those richer than person x is the minimum quiet value between person x and the quietest people among all direct richer connections.

hints.title: Memoized Depth First Search Procedure
hints.text: Build an adjacency list where an edge goes from poorer person to richer person. Initialize an answer array filled with negative one. For each person, recursively query their richer neighbors, taking the person with the minimum quiet value. Cache and return the result for each node.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(V + E) time and O(V + E) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing reachability for every person without caching takes O(V * (V + E)) time, leading to redundant traversals.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoizing results on the DAG ensures each vertex and edge is processed at most once in O(V + E) time and O(V + E) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize DAG properties, select between memoized search or topological order, and correctly report person index rather than quiet value.
